name: bookforge
description: Reflow an app architecture manuscript into a Korean PDF with the bundled Gongnyang Bookforge engine.
whenToUse: 앱 설계 문서나 원고를 PDF로 조판해 달라고 할 때 사용한다. 원문 내용을 보존하고 Bookforge 품질 게이트 결과를 보고한다.

inputs.designPath: Existing absolute path to the application architecture Markdown manuscript
inputs.outDir: Fresh absolute output directory for the isolated Bookforge project
inputs.title: One-line title for the design PDF

outputs.pdfPath: Final PDF path only after the Bookforge QC gate passes
outputs.sourceSha256: SHA-256 of the unchanged input manuscript
outputs.visualReviewRequired: True until the generated contact sheet has been inspected

examples: 이 앱의 ARCHITECTURE.md를 Bookforge로 PDF 조판해줘
Reflow this app design Markdown into a PDF

aiTools.name: bookforge_app_docs_pdf
aiTools.description: Reflow an existing app architecture Markdown manuscript into a PDF with bundled Bookforge. Returns a final path only after its QC gate passes; does not publish.

bookforge-app-docs-pdf.purpose: Reflow an existing app architecture Markdown into a QC-checked Bookforge PDF
